description: Phase 8 cross-backend validation on ibm_kingston for mitigated gr_beta_bump_n4 using the opt-3 seed-45678 candidate. This tests whether the localized-profile instability seen on ibm_fez is backend-specific.
rationale: The Phase 7 Fez repeat left gr_beta_bump_n4 as a backend diagnostic distribution, with useful but biased mean_x and call payoff functionals.
A Kingston repeat tests whether localized-profile instability is device-specific.
The campaign keeps the best audited opt-3 seed-45678 candidate and measures only direct distribution loading.

selected_cases.label: beta-like localized bump, 16 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: Cross-backend validation of the localized n=4 profile.

stopping_rules: If Kingston improves TVD below 0.04, reclassify localized-profile instability as backend-dependent.
If Kingston remains near or above Fez TVD, keep localized profiles as diagnostic on current noisy hardware.
Do not attach Grover amplification in this campaign.
